description: We are a team driven by curiosity, creativity, and the ambition to explore beyond the limits of what we know. We combine technology, storytelling, and problem-solving to transform complex challenges into innovative ideas with real impact. We are passionate about science, space, and discovering new ways to understand the world around us.
summary:
The Forgotten Space Archive is an interactive educational project that explores the history of space missions and the equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. It allows users to discover missions, explore abandoned equipment, learn about their purposes, and understand their scientific and historical significance through visual archives and interactive experiences.

By transforming space exploration information into an accessible learning experience, our project helps people understand that missions leave behind more than scientific discoveries: they also leave objects and stories worth preserving. Our goal is to make space history engaging, encourage curiosity, and highlight the legacy of human and robotic exploration.
details:
The Forgotten Space Archive is an interactive educational website designed to make the history of space exploration more accessible and engaging.

The platform allows users to explore missions to the Moon and Mars, discover spacecraft and equipment left behind, learn about their original purposes, and understand their scientific and historical importance. It combines visual mission archives, interactive explorations, mission profiles, timelines, and educational activities.

Our project addresses the challenge by focusing on the stories behind the equipment that remains after space missions. Instead of presenting isolated facts, it connects objects to the missions, people, and discoveries that made them significant.

We developed the project using Figma Make, with ChatGPT assisting in research organization, brainstorming, writing, and prompt development. Our creative approach combines storytelling, interactive design, and science communication to encourage curiosity and make space history easier to understand.

The intended impact is to help students and the general public appreciate the legacy of space exploration and understand why the objects left behind still matter.
